grammar.title: Should / shouldn't para dar consejos
grammar.explanation: 'Should' recomienda algo y 'shouldn't' desaconseja. Es más suave que 'must'. Va seguido del verbo base.

examples: He shouldn't go to work today.

rules.rule: Pedir consejo: Should I...? / What should I do?

examples: You should rest if you're sick
You shouldn't smoke when you're sick
She has a fever and should see a doctor
You should drink hot tea for a sore throat
She has an allergy to cats

grammar.title: Presente perfecto vs. pasado simple
grammar.explanation: El presente perfecto conecta el pasado con el presente y no dice cuándo. El pasado simple habla de un momento terminado y concreto.

rules.rule: Con just, already, yet, ever, never, recently
examples: She has already seen that movie.
I have worked here for three years.

rules.rule: Pasado simple: con yesterday, last, ago, in 2019
examples: We had dinner two hours ago.
I have just finished my work
I have already seen that movie
I went to the store yesterday
I have recently started a new job
Have you ever been to London?
I have lived here for five years
